# Lead, Manufacturing Engineer, Integration & Test — Relativity Space

---

**Job ID:** Not listed (Greenhouse posting id `8485703002`)
**Date Posted:** Not listed
**Date Applied:** Aug 1, 2026
**Salary Range:** $132,000 – $198,000 USD

---

## Job Summary

Relativity Space is building the Terran R reusable rocket. This role sits on the Mechanisms & Integrated Sub-Assemblies Manufacturing team, currently in design-release/NPI for Terran R, covering pneumatic separation/release mechanisms, linear and rotary electromechanical actuators, and integrated propulsion/avionics assemblies. Onsite in Long Beach, CA.

---

## What You'll Do

- Lead and mentor manufacturing engineers building flight-ready mechanisms and integrated sub-assemblies.
- Own a major mechanized assembly/sub-assembly from design release through production.
- Coordinate cross-functional build execution: planning, sourcing, sequencing, mBOM development, tooling, equipment, and work orders.
- Guide workcenter development (safety, capital investment, tooling, scaling); provide hands-on technical leadership and root-cause analysis; manage team priorities and technical direction.

### Required Qualifications
- 5+ years of relevant experience and a BS in aerospace, mechanical, electrical, manufacturing engineering, or related technical field
- Extensive experience authoring work instructions, mBOMs, and technical procedures for mechanical/electrical/pneumatic assemblies
- Proven cross-functional work with design, manufacturing, production, and quality teams
- Strong understanding of mechanisms manufacturing across mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic systems

Nice to have: leading/mentoring teams, scaling mfg from development to rate production, RCCA/assembly testing/tooling design, capacity analysis/PFMEA/value stream mapping.

### Education
BS in aerospace, mechanical, electrical, manufacturing engineering, or a related technical field.

### Benefits
Competitive salary and equity, generous PTO/sick leave, parental leave, an annual learning and development stipend.

---

## How I Match Up

### At Application — Aug 1, 2026

- **Strong overlap:** 5+ years of relevant experience is met (professional engineering roles since May 2020), BS in Electro-Mechanical Engineering is a direct match, and mechanisms-manufacturing depth is real — linear-motor platform standardization (4-micron precision at 4 m/s with a 30 kg moving mass), POSEIDON's custom gantry and dual-extrusion mechanisms, and the modular CAN-bus controls architecture all involve mechanical/electrical (and CAN-bus, adjacent to pneumatic-systems thinking) integration. "Engineering Documentation and BOM Control" is an explicit skill, closely matching the mBOM-authoring requirement. Team leadership/mentoring (East Coast engineering team oversight, ~5 new hires) matches the "lead and mentor" ask directly.
- **Gap at this date:** as with K2 Space, the live skills list hadn't yet added GD&T, Lean Manufacturing, or Lean Six Sigma as named items, understating capability relevant to "workcenter development" and continuous-improvement duties.
- **Gap:** no explicit pneumatic-systems experience; no PFMEA/value-stream-mapping/RCCA terminology in the record, though Lean Six Sigma methodology and continuous-improvement work is adjacent.
- **Domain gap:** rocketry/aerospace is a new industry relative to additive-manufacturing/prosthetics — transferable electromechanical and manufacturing-systems skill, not direct sector experience.

### Now — Aug 22, 2026

- Same update as noted for K2 Space: GD&T, Lean Manufacturing, and Lean Six Sigma are now explicit skills as of Aug 8, 2026, closing part of the keyword gap.
- Pneumatic-systems and PFMEA/value-stream-mapping gaps remain unchanged.

---

## About the Company

Relativity Space is developing Terran R to deliver customer payloads to orbit at growing launch-capacity demand, describing itself as a place where employees help build "a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up" with autonomy and ownership at every level.
